## Local Docker qualification, 2026-10-08
reference: Nextflow 26.04.6, Docker Engine 29.8.2, Linux amd64
source: copies of nf-core-text/pipelines at the revisions in nf-core-text/revisions.txt; no pipeline edits
commands: nice -n 19 nextflow run <copy> -profile test,docker --outdir out -c limits.config; nice -n 19 target/release/iunctus run <copy> -profile test --outdir out -executor local -max-pending 4 -no-cache
limits: reference executor.cpus=4, executor.memory='16 GB'; iunctus uses a fresh XDG_CACHE_HOME per pipeline
comparison: SHA-256 and file lists of published outputs; only pipeline_info/** is excluded; dated names become <time>. No scientific output, FastQC report, MultiQC data or plot is excluded.
evidence: locally excluded .claude/production-readiness-evidence/nfcore-20261008/ retains logs and complete output manifests; temporary source/run/work/cache folders are removed after recording.

## nf-core-rnaseq-local-20261008: nf-core/rnaseq a1fcddd, -profile test, local Docker
native: not run, disk reserve
iunctus: not run, disk reserve
comparison: not performed
verdict: skipped, parity not established
notes: After removing only completed-run images, 44.38 GiB remained free. A conservative 23 GiB allowance would leave 21.38 GiB, below the required 25 GiB reserve. The CPU test-path image upper bound is 6.542 GiB in compressed layers, allowing three times that for stored/extracted images plus 3 GiB for working files and the 30,690,729 bytes of declared data. Inactive GPU, RSEM, Sentieon, HISAT2, Kallisto, UMI, rRNA-removal, contaminant-screening, RustQC, fastp and preseq image branches are excluded from that bound. No RNA-seq image or dataset payload was downloaded; small sample sheets and manifest/header metadata were inspected.

## nf-core-sarek-local-20261008: nf-core/sarek 8ccac7a, -profile test, local Docker
native: exit 1 in 508 s after the disk watchdog sent SIGTERM, 14 partial published files
iunctus: not run, disk reserve
comparison: not performed, reference execution incomplete
verdict: resource blocked, parity not established
notes: Test reads and declared test-genome references total 32,892,911 bytes. Admission had 42.64 GiB free and a 17 GiB image/work allowance; GATK image extraction and concurrent checkout activity exceeded that allowance and triggered the 25 GiB free-space watchdog. The canceled task was GATK4_MARKDUPLICATES. Logs, output hashes and size metadata are retained; source/run/work folders were removed. This is not a pipeline or engine correctness verdict. Later runs stop at a 27 GiB guard to allow cancellation headroom above the 25 GiB reserve.

The earlier exit-33 records are historical and do not qualify the updated binary.
